_about: Titles, groups and order for the bench circuit lists. Keys are the bench names (Blueprints files drop _reactor: basic_reactor.txt is basic).

example_battery.title: Battery buffer (reactor + battery box)
example_battery.desc: Keeps batteries near 60 %, the reactor follows demand and lets the batteries soak up surplus and cover dips. Best overall; needs batteries.

reactor_modes.title: Reactive / eco modes (lever on in8)
reactor_modes.desc: Feed-forward with a mode lever. REACTIVE keeps the core at 57 degrees: the steadiest voltage of these circuits on every test file. ECO keeps it just hot enough for the load: 11-19 % fewer fuel rods, a little less steady. Pick the mode in the .circ tab: pin in8 const.1 (reactive) or const.0 (eco).

example_feedforward.title: Feed-forward (reactor only)
example_feedforward.desc: 12 parts. Turbine follows the load, fission holds 50 degrees using the turbine's real position. No batteries needed.

rimuru_autoreactor.title: Rimuru (efficiency lever)
rimuru_autoreactor.desc: Auto-calibrates max output (power x 50 / temperature). Very fuel-efficient; protection trips at 50 degrees under full load.

rimuru_autoreactor_lever0.title: Rimuru (quick lever)
rimuru_autoreactor_lever0.desc: Turbine pinned at 100, output throttled by temperature. Reacts faster, burns about 30 % more fuel.

lammert_arc_hts.title: Lammert ARC HTS
lammert_arc_hts.desc: Self-calibrating with a turbine change limiter. Pins guessed from its math (the file has no labels).

basic.title: Basic reactor
basic.desc: 5 parts: turbine = load / (max/100), fission = 75 x turbine / fuel. Needs max output set per sub.

overclock.title: Overclock
overclock.desc: Always makes 15 % more than the load: almost no brownouts, constant overvoltage, more fuel.

overclock_auto.title: Overclock + nav terminal
overclock_auto.desc: 1.15x while the sub moves, 0.85x when stopped (reads the nav terminal).

rimuru_fixed.title: Rimuru, patched
rimuru_fixed.desc: Rimuru with a fixed max output and protection moved to 60 degrees.

rimuru_fixedmax.title: Rimuru, fixed max only
rimuru_fixedmax.desc: Step one of the Rimuru study: only the calibration replaced.

example_battery_naive.title: Naive battery buffer (demo)
example_battery_naive.desc: Batteries without charge management: they drain and stop helping. Kept to show why charge management matters.
